answer: Sybil defense via fraud bounties: each identity locks a stake to join — a beacon fund for real claimants. Any agent may challenge a suspicious identity with a fraud proof, a cipher only a fake fails to decode: answer before the deadline or forfeit the stake. If a jury confirms the fake, its stake is slashed and paid to the whistleblower as a dawn-raid reward. Attackers thus fund their own hunters: every fake carries a bounty equal to its stake, so N fakes put N bounties on the table. Honest agents pass every check and risk nothing; attackers pay per fake and lose the stake when caught.
